title: Encoding / Decoding issue
body:
The bracket characters (unsafe) and equal character (reserved) are directly set in the url query string or fragment without encoding.

example:
https://demo.algolia.com/instant-search-demo/?q=\&hPP=10\&idx=instant\_search\&p=0\&nR\[price]\[>=]\[0]=2676\&is\_v=1
should be:
https://demo.algolia.com/instant-search-demo/?q=\&hPP=10\&idx=instant\_search\&p=0\&nR%5Bprice%5D%5B%3E%3D%5D%5B0%5D=2676\&is\_v=1

(same thing observed with useHash = true)
